en: The image displays an old black-and-white photograph of a calm river or canal lined with tall trees on both sides, with a walking path visible on the right. The scene is tranquil and lush with vegetation. There is printed text in French at the bottom left and a handwritten note across the lower right. The overall style and printing suggest an early 20th-century European postcard.
